user.title: ePaperEngine
user.description: Set up the integration. The display, views, schedules, calendars, recipes, photos and guest mode are configured afterwards in the ePaperEngine panel.

get_render_data.name: Get render data
get_render_data.description: Returns everything the add-on needs for one render run in a single document: the target view, the deterministic photo counter, the recipe selection, the guest fields and the layout parameters. The renderer pulls, Home Assistant does not push — so no request schema has to be maintained on both sides.

report_run.name: Report run
report_run.description: Records the outcome of a render run. Called by the add-on once a run finishes, successfully or not; it is what makes the run visible in the status sensor and on the dashboard card.

result.name: Result
result.description: What the run did. 'unchanged' is a normal outcome, not a failure: an image identical to the last one is deliberately not pushed.

error.name: Error
error.description: Plain-text reason when the run failed. Shown on the card.

warning.name: Warning
warning.description: Set when the run succeeded but something was missing — a single unavailable calendar source, for instance.

image_hash.name: Image hash
image_hash.description: Hash of the rendered PNG, used to tell an actual change from a repeat.

pushed.name: Pushed
pushed.description: Whether the image really went to the display. Only then is the last-push time updated.

render.name: Render
render.description: Triggers a render run. The image is only pushed to the display when it actually changed — unless 'force' is set.

force.name: Force push
force.description: Send the image even when it is unchanged. This is the panel's 'Push now'; use it when the display missed a picture.

set_view.name: Set view
set_view.description: Pins a view by hand. It overrules the priority list until the manual timeout expires; calling the service without a view hands control back to the automatic resolution.

view.name: View
view.description: Which view to pin. Leave empty to return to automatic.

sync_recipes.name: Sync recipes
sync_recipes.description: Pulls the recipe collection from Paprika into the local cache. Only what has changed is fetched. Do not call this per render run — the API is documented to ban by IP; that is what the sync interval is for.

set_guests.name: Set guest mode
set_guests.description: Switches guest mode on or off. While it is on, the wall shows the guest greeting — name, greeting line and the chosen background — and it stays on until it is switched off; unlike a view pinned by hand, it does not lapse after a few hours.

active.name: Guest mode
active.description: On when visitors are in the house, off when they have left.

sync_anniversaries.name: Sync anniversaries
sync_anniversaries.description: Writes the year count into the anniversary calendar itself, so a phone shows what the wall shows. Only sources marked as anniversaries are touched, and only CalDAV ones can be written to. Entries whose title is already correct cost no request at all, so a daily automation is harmless.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: On by default. Reports what would change without altering anything. Switch it off to actually write.

limit.name: At most
limit.description: How many entries may be written in this run. Leave empty for all — set it to 1 to try a single entry first.
